headline: Solana Imposes 1 SOL Submission Fee to Block AI-Generated Bug Spam
summary: Solana now requires researchers to permanently burn 1 SOL for every bug report submitted, following a contest that drew 809 submissions largely generated or written using artificial intelligence.
why: Solana is a top layer-1 blockchain ecosystem; managing developer resources and security bounty programs is critical to preserving its technical development pipeline.

impacts.name: Solana
impacts.why: The fee burns tokens and curbs AI spam, but introduces an upfront cost for security researchers.
